method: Regions: an offline energy speech finder on the caller track (frame RMS against the track's noise floor, 400 ms pause splits, 80 ms padding), aligned to the event timeline from the user.turn starts (offsetMs). Regions where the live call opened a user turn but the track is near-silent were added as nonSpeech (ids -nNN). Transcripts: every region was transcribed by 8 streaming configurations (Scribe v2 realtime auto/en/hi/en+hi/en+keyterms, AssemblyAI Universal-Streaming English and Multilingual, Universal-3.6 Pro hi+en) and 2 batch models (Scribe v2 batch, AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro with language detection), plus the live call's own finals; the gold is a reconciliation of those by agreement between independent model families (Scribe vs AssemblyAI, streaming vs batch) and the conversation's context. Nobody listened to the audio: low-confidence utterances are listed for the founder to check.
